ratings_why.fun: The cards overlap in ways I want to solve: Paracel and Warden Quench pass the Hottest around, Mother Atra's empty slots fight the Curator's Hot ring, and burns guarantee Smooth Tobias heats himself every fight.
ratings_why.distinct: Decaying Heat that pays more when reheated, plus self-burns you choose to suffer, redirect or fire back, plays unlike any of today's tribes; a few cards are plain counter-tribe stuff.

verdict_why: The v1 readability fixes landed and nothing is broken; more passes would change the tribe, not improve it.

points.text: Ember-Slinger and Yellowback Spitter cancel out because your unit no longer burns. Letting Spitter fire whenever your Heat burns anyone would make the two a greedy late-game combo instead of a choice.
Quench-Bucket Lad could pour the removed Heat into a unit next to the target, so a quench also starts the next piece warming: one more positional hop in the Quench and Reheat line.
Burns make Smooth Tobias take damage every fight, so he heats himself forever. That self-feeding loop is the tribe's best hidden combo; worth naming in the builds.
Slag Picker is the one card with no positional or Heat decision. Tie the Ingot to the sold unit, for example Heat equal to the sold unit's Heat, so selling a hot piece is a choice.
Mirror matches get fun if the enemy's Spitter fires when Ember-Slinger hands it Heat; a line saying whose Spitter counts would settle it.

standouts.why: Masterpiece Hall Curator turns the board into a puzzle: ring the piece with Hot neighbours, against Mother Atra wanting those slots empty.
Yellowback Spitter makes your own burns a weapon, and the Shield trick uses a keyword against its intended purpose.
Warden Quench cashes the Hottest and spreads Heat, so with Paracel the Hottest moves every turn and you plan two turns ahead.

weakest.why: Slag Picker is a generic sell-for-item engine with no tie to Heat or position.
Slag Row Journeyman is a one-time heat-yourself body that drops out fast.
Burn-Salve Matron is a passive aura whose payoff rounds to almost nothing until Health is high.

flags.note: Curator plus Crater Forge Master, Thiers Grinder and the Undying Furnace stacks many Reforges on climbing Heat; needs the late-game sim.
Golden Keeper heats every unit each turn with no cooling, so the whole board grows quadratically.
Ottilie's Attack-and-Health Regrow on every unit feeds itself; needs the runaway check.
